title: Touch Pad
notes: Nikita Visual Arts - nikitavisual.art. One-page UCI for the Nikita Touch Pad plugin, 500 x 500 pad at (78, 112).
Geometry: picker surface (40, 100) 955 x 524 = ceil(1.91 x 500) x (500 + 24); pad = picker top-left + (round(0.04 x 955), 12); cover = picker grown by 2 px on each side.
Keys x, y, w, h, type, variant, control, text, label, font_size, color are the build.py schema.

Keys css_class, text_color, stroke_color, stroke_width, corner_radius are applied after build.py with the toolkit's library (uci.py): css_class -> Object+_CssClassName, text_color -> _Color/Object+_Color only (not _Fill), stroke_color -> _StrokeColor, stroke_width -> _StrokeWidth, corner_radius -> _CornerRadius.
The Color Picker surface and the plugin's three Display copies are not in this file: the template has no Color Picker prototype and the Display control has no pin.

elements.role: cover: page-coloured group box over the Color Picker surface (40, 100) 955 x 524
pad placeholder in the Sunset pad colour: the three Display copies go exactly here
